description: Building code compliance software that runs inside Revit and checks a design against municipal codes in seconds, flagging violations with the relevant code section and suggested fixes. Used mainly by architecture firms, with early work toward municipal permitting.

AI agent platform for AEC firms that works with drawings, specs and models to review drawings against standards and codes, prepare submittals and RFIs, and now generate and revise native CAD drawings. Agents run inside Revit, AutoCAD and Procore with human approval of every change.
funding: Undisclosed strategic round from Aurecon and Arcadis (Sep 2026)

description: Land acquisition and site feasibility software for homebuilders and developers that automates site plans, lot-yield estimates and entitlement research, and now drafts subdivision site plans.
Laser-scanning firm that builds 3D digital twins of existing buildings and has launched qentin, an AI agent that lets facility teams search scans in natural language and detect and label assets.
Browser-based collaborative design tool for interior and space planning, combining 2D drafting with a new 3D canvas, an AI agent that converts PDFs and lays out zones and furniture, and AI rendering.

Agentic platform for development and construction management whose AI agents draft RFIs, chase submittals, write daily reports and flag budget variances against bids, budgets, change orders and commitments. Integrates with QuickBooks and Sage accounting systems.

AI platform for building materials manufacturers that finds relevant tenders, reads bills of quantities and specifications, matches requirements to the product catalog and drafts quotes and orders in the manufacturer's CRM and ERP.

AI platform that reviews drawing sets, combining PDFs with Revit model data, for code, coordination, specification and constructability issues, citing a source for each finding. It also offers a project copilot, RFI and submittal tracking, and a searchable detail library.

Builds AI-driven robotic attachments that mount on existing jobsite equipment such as skid steers and forklifts to automate pick-and-place, transport and assembly, starting with utility-scale solar panel installation.

Rule-based building configurator that encodes a building type's design standards, modules and cost logic so teams can adapt and validate repeatable building series on new sites. Products include a residential plot feasibility tool with cost and return estimates and a browser-based BIM modeler.

Managed commercial permitting service for organizations building many sites across many jurisdictions, where in-house specialists supported by AI and tracking software move projects from application through plan-review comments to approval.

AI assistant for complex construction projects that reads drawings, specifications, contracts, schedules and site records, answers questions with page-level citations and flags changes such as reissued drawings or moved dates. It connects read-only to existing document systems.
AI software for construction lending that pulls data from scattered project documents to reconcile budgets, calculate loan draws and produce lender-ready reports.

Collaborative planning and delivery platform for large construction and infrastructure projects. It connects the master programme to lookaheads, weekly work plans, resources, briefings, production tracking and site diaries.

AI-native construction management software that runs a contractor's project from bidding to closeout in one system, including RFIs, submittals, drawings, takeoffs, daily logs, punch lists and change orders, with AI search across project data and flat-rate pricing.
Kamai builds an AI takeoff engine that reads construction drawings, including scanned PDFs, to detect and measure rooms, openings and materials, and offers it as a plugin or API for estimating tools.

Construction data integration company that began with a unified API linking contractors' ERP, accounting and project management systems. It now also offers AI agents for back-office work such as invoice matching, compliance, billing and financial reporting.

AI bid assistant for commercial glazing contractors that drafts scopes, runs takeoffs, prepares RFIs and vendor RFQs, levels quotes and assembles proposals, with a human estimating manager reviewing the AI's work.

Construction cost data company offering localized material, labor and equipment pricing through an API and its own estimating app. Its pricing data is embedded in other estimating and takeoff tools, largely for residential and specialty contractors.

AI project-accounting platform for builders. Its agents handle job costing, payables, billing, WIP, forecasting and change orders on top of a contractor's existing accounting system, with a person approving each action.
San Jose-area commercial builder offering design-build and construction management, along with its own software that gives clients and trade partners budgets, cost tracking and live project updates.

AI platform for real estate developers that turns an address into a deal analysis covering feasibility, zoning, market data and pro forma. It grew out of software for designing repeatable low-carbon mass timber buildings.
Amsterdam-based bid and tender management software with AI agents that draft answers, flag risks and surface win/loss patterns. It serves several sectors, construction among them.

Spinout from Alphabet's X that gathers zoning, codes, cost, materials and site data into one early-stage workspace. It generates site plans and building designs and evaluates them for compliance, function and financial viability.
Platform for residential HVAC contractors that analyzes homes, sizes heat pump systems and helps line up financing and incentives so installations close faster.
AI property platform combining site feasibility and generative design with automated planning-compliance checks that councils use to speed up development approvals.

Cloud tool that extracts quantities and properties from BIM models so preconstruction teams can condition, filter and compare model versions for takeoff and estimating. It is now part of Autodesk Construction Cloud.
Maker of Beam AI, which automatically measures quantities from construction plans for contractors and suppliers. The company also builds AI tools for landscaping and field-service businesses.

Design and make software company whose AECO portfolio covers BIM authoring (Revit), early-stage planning (Forma) and Autodesk Construction Cloud for preconstruction, bidding, takeoff, cost and field management.
Financial management app for contractors covering estimates, invoicing, change orders, bill pay, expenses and lien waivers, alongside a business account and card.

Developer of the DESTINI preconstruction suite, with tools for parametric conceptual estimating, detailed and model-based estimating, and design options analysis. It added AI takeoff through the Workpack acquisition.
AI bid-leveling tool for general contractor preconstruction teams that extracts line items from subcontractor bid PDFs and normalizes them for side-by-side comparison.
AI platform that reads construction blueprints to generate takeoffs and cost estimates and to pre-check plans for code compliance before permitting.
PDF markup and collaboration software used across AEC teams to review drawings, measure 2D takeoffs and coordinate document sets in shared live sessions.

AI software that uses computer vision to automate quantity takeoffs and estimates from construction plans. It began in landscaping and is expanding into electrical, drywall, HVAC, plumbing and framing.

Agentic AI layer that reads tender documents, drawings and contracts so construction teams can analyze bids, manage requirements, assemble procurement packages and review contracts, with answers linked to sources. It sits on top of existing file stores.
Financial automation and AI agent software for contractors that automates job cost forecasting, budgeting, change orders and back-office workflows on top of existing ERP and project systems.
funding: Strategic investment from Nemetschek Group, undisclosed, Jan 2024

description: Autodesk's bid management network for commercial construction, where GCs and owners invite subcontractors to bid, compare bids and assess sub risk, and trades receive and track invitations.

Preconstruction workspace for general contractors that combines CRM, estimating, bidding, forecasting and workforce planning, with an AI agent that searches past estimates, assembles proposals and checks capacity.
Estimating, quoting and job management software for residential builders and remodelers, with AI-assisted takeoff, live supplier pricing and accounting integrations.
Saudi digital procurement platform for construction and real estate that connects contractors with suppliers and offers embedded trade credit and AI-assisted material purchasing.

Materials procurement platform for residential and modular builders that suggests vendors from uploaded bills of materials, tracks spend against budget, handles payment and follows orders through delivery.
German digital marketplace that screens landowners' plots for wind-farm potential and matches pre-assessed sites with wind project developers through a structured bidding process.

AI-assisted owner's engineering firm for gas-fired power projects that takes them from concept to investment decision, producing plot plans, process balances, electrical diagrams, cost estimates and schedules stamped by licensed engineers.
Builds a semi-autonomous drywall finishing system that uses a robotic arm and computer vision to spray and sand joint compound to high finish levels, run by a skilled operator.
Shared change-order platform where GCs, specialty contractors and owners log change requests, sign photo-backed T&M tags on mobile, track allowances and contingency, and sync pricing to their ERP.
AI-native preconstruction platform for general contractors that unifies pursuit, pre-planning, budgeting, procurement and buyout, structuring historical project data with an agentic assistant on top.

Japanese all-in-one management software for small and mid-sized construction firms covering customers, projects, estimates, cost and margin tracking, ordering and scheduling, with AI agents that draft estimates and digitize paper quotes.

Commercial preconstruction data and software company offering project lead intelligence and bid management alongside takeoff and estimating products such as On-Screen Takeoff, PlanSwift, Quick Bid and QuoteSoft.

All-in-one construction management software for small and mid-sized contractors covering scheduling, daily logs, estimating, change orders, purchasing, invoicing, time cards, safety and a client portal, at a low monthly price.

Cloud estimating and tender management software for building and infrastructure projects, where users price bills of quantities from their own historical rates, compare subcontractor and supplier quotes, and analyze costs.

Long-established cloud construction software for estimating, project management and job costing, with a free portal where owners, designers and subcontractors exchange and comment on project documents.

North American partner and reseller of the CostOS enterprise estimating software (developed by Nomitech), which supports estimates from early parametric classes through detailed line-item estimates with 2D/3D takeoff for construction, engineering and energy projects. The Memphis team also provides implementation and estimating expertise.

Cloud takeoff and estimating software for fire alarm, security, sprinkler and other M&E trades that automatically counts devices on drawings, checks detection coverage and prices the job. It is part of TAG Software Group within Valsoft.
funding: Acquired by Valsoft (TAG Software Group); year not disclosed

description: Agentic AI platform for construction and engineering teams that connects to project systems and runs agents for document search, submittal and RFI review, scope checks, prequalification and daily logs. Now part of Procore.

Paris-based AI company that produces early-stage development studies for real estate projects, including feasibility, site analysis, massing and floor plans. Its own generative design models are paired with expert human review, and it is delivered as a service.

AI-assisted collaboration platform for home builders and their suppliers that keeps plans, specs, selections, approvals and warranties in one place, automates tasks such as material takeoffs, and hands homeowners a digital model of their home.
Generative AI estimating system for electrical contractors that reads 2D floor plans, PDFs, specs and schedules to produce takeoffs and cost estimates.

Planning and data management platform for defining and validating building requirements (rooms, equipment, functions) across the project lifecycle, with two-way sync to Revit, Archicad and IFC and handover to FM via COBie. Owned by Nemetschek.
Business software for landscaping and lawn care companies that measures properties from aerial imagery with AI and combines design, estimating, CRM and invoicing in a mobile app.
Sales software for residential HVAC and home-electrification contractors that generates instant, personalized homeowner quotes using property data, equipment matching and local rebates.

Cloud-based preconstruction estimating platform for general contractors that combines cost modeling, collaborative estimate building and live reporting. It also connects with takeoff tools so quantities flow straight into estimates.

Peruvian B2B platform that digitizes construction materials buying for small and mid-sized builders. It links contractors to a network of suppliers and bundles quoting, ordering, credit and delivery in one workflow.

AI-driven asset and field service management software for equipment-heavy service companies. It automates the path from quote to job, tracks shop and field work in real time and helps reduce equipment downtime.

Takeoff and estimating software built for specialty subcontractors such as drywall, acoustical, flooring, painting, roofing and concrete. Products include a desktop estimating system, on-screen and smart takeoff tools and integrations with accounting software.

Tech-enabled residential fencing company that lets homeowners get instant quotes and buy fence projects online. Partner installers get a steady flow of jobs plus pricing, materials and back-office support.

Web and mobile platform for capturing tamper-evident site evidence such as photos, forms and records on construction, infrastructure and utility projects. Contractors use it to prove work quality and compliance to clients and to report through dashboards.
AI software for residential solar installers that brings sales, system design, job setup and post-install monitoring into one tool.

AI procurement software for contractors that digitizes quotes, purchase orders, delivery tickets and invoices for materials and equipment. It syncs the data into construction accounting systems and adds inventory and pricing insight.

Field service management software for HVAC, plumbing and electrical service businesses, covering scheduling, dispatch, estimates, invoicing and asset tracking. It adds AI tools that answer calls, book jobs and capture web leads.

AI design review and risk analysis platform that scans construction drawings and specs to flag missing details, cross-discipline conflicts and scope gaps before bidding and building. It also compares drawing sets across design stages to catch changes.

Generative AI tool for structural engineering that takes architectural PDFs or CAD files and proposes several physics-checked structural framing options with material lists. It aims to cut engineering time and material use, with an emphasis on wood-frame buildings.

French software developer and Autodesk Platinum Partner that builds structural analysis, steel detailing and Revit/AutoCAD add-on tools, and resells Autodesk products with BIM training, consulting and support.

Permitting company that pairs AI-assisted plan review with third-party code compliance experts to help developers and builders move projects through feasibility, plan review and permit approval faster.

Amsterdam homebuilding platform where buyers choose or customise prefab homes and garden houses, with Haaven coordinating vetted architects, offsite builders and contractors along with budget and timeline.
AI assistant for residential remodelers and contractors that produces estimates and handles back-office work, alongside CRM, project management and financial tools in one platform.
Software for heavy civil and infrastructure contractors covering estimating and bidding, job costing, field reporting, safety and fleet management, from preconstruction through project closeout.

German cloud and mobile business software for small trade firms, covering quotes and cost calculation, scheduling boards, time tracking, invoicing, payments and links to supplier catalogues and accounting tools.

Cloud platform for production homebuilders that uses AI trained on residential plans to generate 3D home models, construction documents, takeoffs and cost estimates, plus buyer sales tools and supplier pricing links.

AI-native architectural design software that turns sketches, diagrams, renderings or text prompts into editable 2D and 3D building models exportable to Revit. It has also launched an agentic 3D modeling workspace.

InEight provides a connected suite of project controls software for capital construction, covering estimating, scheduling, cost control, change, contracts, documents, model-based workflows and completions. It is used by owners, contractors and engineers on large infrastructure, energy and industrial programs.

INGENIOUS.BUILD is a project and portfolio management platform for real estate development and construction, combining budgets, commitments and forecasts with RFIs, submittals, schedules, construction administration and capital planning. It targets owners, developers and their project teams.

insightsoftware sells financial reporting, planning and analytics software, including Excel-based reporting packages for construction finance teams that connect to construction ERPs such as Viewpoint, Spectrum, Sage and COINS for job cost, cash flow and profitability reporting.

Installio is a London-based clean energy installer that pairs its own heat pump engineering teams with a project management platform for large retrofit programmes, giving energy suppliers, housebuilders and housing associations visibility into install progress and compliance.

JobNimbus is a CRM and job management platform for roofing and exterior contractors, covering leads, estimates, job workflows, supplier ordering, payments and homeowner financing, with an enterprise tier for multi-location operators.
funding: $330M growth investment from Sumeru Equity Partners (Nov 2024)

description: Join is a preconstruction decision platform that tracks cost trends, design decisions, risks and schedule impacts through the design phase, giving owners, contractors and design teams a shared record of how the budget evolves.
funding: Undisclosed strategic investment from DPR (WND Ventures) and STO Building Group (Sep 2025)

description: Kai is an AI renovation planning tool that analyzes photos and videos of a property to scope the work and produce SKU-level material lists and cost estimates, which can be ordered through The Home Depot.

Kaliun is an AI-first CRM and job management platform for residential contractors, covering proposals, project and milestone tracking, subcontractor coordination, expense tracking, invoicing and client communication.

Kojo is a materials procurement and inventory platform for specialty contractors, linking field requests, purchasing quotes, warehouse stock, tool tracking, vendor EDI and invoice matching in one system.
